scope: Offline recomputation of three saved planned RobotStates only; not execution or an additional scene.

diagnostic.header: [mtc_planner-3] [ERROR] [1790269040.716143252] [astribot_s1_manipulation.external_trajectory]: EXTERNAL_COLLISION_SNAPSHOT frame=astribot_torso_base group=arm_left first_bad_index=41 checked_states=788 trajectory_waypoints=788 reason=environment collision: transport_box_01<->transport_box_01_pick_station

method.joint_mapping: All 36 joint values read from each complete logged RobotState. URDF continuous wheel values map to [cos(q),sin(q)] for Pinocchio nq=2 joints. No missing values defaulted.
method.fk_crosscheck: Independently traverse saved URDF root-to-TCP chain using origin RPY and local joint axis rotation; compare all 16 transform elements.
method.eight_corners: For each sx,sy,sz in {-1,+1}, c=[sx*dx/2,sy*dy/2,sz*dz/2]; p_frame=R_frame_shape*c+t_frame_shape.
method.clearance: Transform corners into saved station-local frame; clearance=min(corner_z)-station_half_height. Positive means above support plane.
method.obb_intersection: 15-axis separating-axis test for the two actual box geometries: station axes, rotated box axes, and pairwise cross-products; skip degenerate axes. Positive projected interval separation on any axis proves no intersection.
method.nominal_comparison: Use physical fixture dimensions [0.06,0.06,0.12] at the same authoritative attachment pose. Do not replace or shrink the conservative geometry in runtime.
method.world_transform_boundary: Primary collision/clearance calculations use saved planning frame station. World coordinates additionally use saved fixture base-from-gazebo-world transform, not an assumed identity.

conclusion: The first TRANSPORT_POSTURE state is the lifted state and is clear of the station. By planned sample index 41 the TCP has moved downward and toward negative x, while the payload pitches about 11.64 degrees. The payload center drops about 18.207 mm and its conservative projected half-height increases about 6.315 mm, exhausting the initial 24.264 mm support clearance. The conservative box intersects the station, while the nominal physical box retains about 6.590 mm vertical clearance. Thus the conservative loaded path begins lowering/rotating before clearing the support footprint; this is not an accidental reuse of the attachment initial state in these three snapshots. The last state is lower but laterally clear.
minimal_direction: Keep authoritative conservative dimensions and collision rejection. Replan or segment the transport retreat so the payload clears the support footprint at preserved height/orientation before lowering/rotating toward compact posture; alternatively feed the same conservative attachment to the initial planner. The selected final approach must still pass whole remaining-path revalidation.
limits: Only first, first-rejected, and last planned states were logged. This does not reconstruct all 788 waypoints or prove the remaining path safe.
The support object used offline is the saved initial full PlanningScene object, equal to fixtures final_scene. The rejected cached stage full scene itself was not separately dumped.
OBB SAT independently checks the specific payload-station box pair; it does not rerun full MoveIt/FCL collision checking or other robot/environment pairs.
The physical nominal box being clear does not justify reducing the authoritative conservative envelope or exempting later support collisions.
The diagnostic samples are planned states evaluated before executing LIFT/TRANSPORT_POSTURE, not actual executed states.

endpoint_retreat_candidates.basis: Translate all eight conservative corners of the scene27 first (lifted) snapshot without rotation, keeping the existing +30 mm lift height. Station uses saved planning-frame geometry; displacements explicitly use gazebo_world axes.
endpoint_retreat_candidates.recommendation: Both 100 mm and 120 mm world -Y endpoints fully clear the conservative payload from the station. 120 mm provides about 28.2 mm lateral endpoint clearance versus about 8.2 mm at 100 mm, and is the stronger of these two bounded fixture candidates if reachable.
limits: These values are endpoint geometry only and do not prove Cartesian lift/retreat or subsequent OMPL transport path collision freedom.

With the existing single pick_exit target, changing its XY produces one combined lift-and-retreat segment from the grasp target; it does not add a separately verified vertical-then-horizontal two-segment motion.
If M1 changes the fixture, retain actual remaining-path revalidation and all conservative geometry/collision checks. No additional support exemption is implied.
